title: SharePoint Developer
summary: SharePoint developers build intranets, team sites and document apps on SharePoint Online, a cloud platform for company sites and files. They sit in an IT or Microsoft 365 team and write SPFx web parts (custom page blocks built with React) linked to low-code forms, automated workflows and Microsoft 365 data.
dailyDuties: Build SPFx web parts in React and TypeScript
Set up sites, lists, libraries and permissions
Pull Microsoft 365 data through Microsoft Graph
Build Power Automate flows and Power Apps forms around lists
Script site setup and migration with PowerShell
Meet business users to gather needs and demo changes

skills.expectation: Build sites, lists and SPFx web parts on SharePoint Online
Build SPFx web parts with React
Read and write Microsoft 365 data through Microsoft Graph or PnPjs
Automate approvals and document flows around SharePoint
Build or embed Power Apps forms on SharePoint lists
Call SharePoint REST and other web APIs
Style web parts and pages to match the brand
Gather needs from business users and train site owners
Script site provisioning and migration with PnP PowerShell
Write Azure Functions or back-end services in C#
Understand Microsoft 365 admin settings and permissions
Package and deploy SPFx solutions with a pipeline
